title: One LLM request made by the harness (one line of RESULTS/usage-events.jsonl)
description: Token fields are normalized per SPEC §17.4: input_tokens excludes cache reads and writes; output_tokens includes reasoning. A native source that only reports per-turn totals may emit one aggregated event per turn with requests > 1 (SPEC §17.5).

ts.description: Request completion time, UTC (end of the turn for aggregated events).

component.description: Harness component that issued the request, with version, e.g. "claude-code@2.1.300", "codex@0.60.0", "planner".

agent_id.description: Stable id of the agent/session that made the request.

purpose.description: Free text such as main, subagent, review, compaction, auxiliary (Claude Code: query_source).

account.description: Gateway key or provider workspace the request was billed to (no secrets).

speed.description: Provider speed mode if priced differently, e.g. Claude Code fast mode.

service_tier.description: e.g. OpenAI default / priority / flex, Anthropic standard / priority.

requests.description: 1 for a single request; more for an aggregated per-turn event.

request_id.description: Provider request or message id of a single request, when available.

request_ids.description: Aggregated events: ids of the requests they cover, when known.

status.description: error = the request failed but was billed.

cache_write_1h_tokens.description: Part of cache_write_tokens written with a 1-hour TTL; null if the source does not report the split.

reasoning_tokens.description: Subset of output_tokens, only if the provider reports it separately.

cost_usd.description: Filled in by kit/accounting/verify from prices.json; a harness estimate here is ignored.

source.description: Native record the event was derived from.
